import hashlib
import json
import math
import pathlib
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
source_json = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\xiemo\Desktop\ShardForge\vesselforge\tmp\review_20261006\global_bspline_meridian_20261006\minimum_jerk_candidate\minimum_jerk_exact_result.json")
out = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\xiemo\Desktop\ShardForge\vesselforge\tmp\review_20261006\global_bspline_meridian_20261006\minimum_jerk_candidate\minimum_jerk_outer_profiles.png")
result = json.loads(source_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
cases = json.loads((root / "vesselforge/experiments/global_bspline_meridian_20261006/fixed_cases.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["cases"]

def bezier_at(poles, t):
    work = [tuple(point) for point in poles]
    while len(work) > 1:
        work = [tuple((1.0 - t) * a + t * b for a, b in zip(work[i], work[i + 1])) for i in range(len(work) - 1)]
    return work[0]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 6))
legend_handles = None
for ax, family in zip(axes, ("bowl", "jar")):
    case = cases[family]
    spans = result["cases"][family]["geometry"]["spans"]
    points = []
    for span in spans:
        poles = [tuple(float(value) for value in point) for point in span["bezier_poles_rz_mm"]]
        points.extend(bezier_at(poles, j / 200.0) for j in range(201))
    radius = [point[0] for point in points]
    height = [point[1] for point in points]
    outer_line, = ax.plot(radius, height, color="#315b7d", linewidth=1.8, label="outer-body meridian")
    ax.plot([-r for r in radius], height, color="#315b7d", linewidth=1.8)
    apex_r = float(case["fixed_dimensions"]["max_outer_radius_mm"])
    apex_z = float(case["fixed_dimensions"]["apex_z_mm"])
    mouth_r = float(case["fixed_dimensions"]["outer_mouth_r_mm"])
    mouth_z = float(case["fixed_dimensions"]["mouth_datum_z_mm"])
    apex = ax.scatter([-apex_r, apex_r], [apex_z, apex_z], color="#c45a3c", s=24, zorder=3, label="fixed max-radius apex")
    mouth = ax.scatter([-mouth_r, mouth_r], [mouth_z, mouth_z], color="#4a8a63", s=20, zorder=3, label="mouth/body endpoint")
    ax.set_title(f"{family.title()} outer body\nmouth datum {mouth_z:g} mm; crest target {case['accepted_candidate_total_height_mm']} mm unbuilt")
    ax.set_xlabel("signed radius r (mm)")
    ax.set_ylabel("height z (mm)")
    ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.22)
    ax.set_xlim(-1.12 * apex_r, 1.12 * apex_r)
    ax.set_ylim(-1, 1.05 * mouth_z)
    if legend_handles is None:
        legend_handles = [outer_line, apex, mouth]
fig.legend(legend_handles, [handle.get_label() for handle in legend_handles], loc="lower center", ncol=3, frameon=False)
fig.suptitle("Frozen minimum-jerk profiles; 201 samples per exact Bezier span for display only", y=0.97)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.08, 1, 0.92))
fig.savefig(out, dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)
print(json.dumps({"png": str(out), "png_bytes": out.stat().st_size, "png_sha256": hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "source_json_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_json.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "display_samples_per_span": 201, "render_only_no_control_solve": True}, separators=(",", ":")))
